propositions: A new NDJSON snapshot file appended per CI run must persist timestamped code-health metrics (coverage, complexity, clone count) to enable trend tracking.
The snapshot store must live at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` (a git-tracked path), not under `reports/`, so the series accumulates and syncs across commits.
The `.gitignore` file must add `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` negation to un-ignore the snapshot file despite the blanket `.rebar/*` rule.
The `write_snapshot(dict)` function appends a record to the NDJSON file and `read_snapshots(since, until)` yields in-range records, skipping malformed lines without raising errors.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read, date-range filtering, corrupt-line handling, and that the snapshot file is not matched by the gitignore rules.
